description: An iterator attribute with an attribute access is an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so this mistake affects no block. hashicorp/hcl checks the iterator attribute when it reads the dynamic block, before it evaluates for_each (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: Dynamic iterator must be a single variable name
